title: The 5 Smallest Countries on Earth, Ranked (#1 Is Under Half a Square Kilometer)

scenes.text: Number one is smaller than half a square kilometer. And it is still a country.

scenes.label: San Marino · 61 km²
scenes.text: Number five: San Marino. Sixty-one square kilometers, and it is completely surrounded by Italy.

scenes.label: Tuvalu · 26 km²
scenes.text: Number four: Tuvalu. About twenty-six square kilometers of low coral islands in the Pacific.

scenes.label: Nauru · 21 km²
scenes.text: Number three: Nauru. Twenty-one square kilometers, the smallest island nation on Earth.

scenes.label: Monaco · 2 km²
scenes.text: Number two: Monaco. About two square kilometers, smaller than New York's Central Park.

scenes.label: Vatican City · 0.44 km²
scenes.text: Number one: Vatican City. Less than half a square kilometer, with its own flag and its own postage stamps.

description:
The five smallest countries on Earth, ranked by total area.
The smallest is under half a square kilometer, and the biggest of the five could fit inside a small town's limits.
Which of these would you most like to visit?
first_comment: Which tiny country would you visit first? And what should we rank next?
